items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: This fellow, Henry Martin, that I was telling you about, that was his mother's place.

ctx.x: Well, uh, when you went to school, did they teach music there? No.
They teach us their music there. What school did you go to? I went to Fisk and MacDonald 24. Where is Fisk? It was at the corner of Franklin and Perdita. Was that Ms. Martin's place?
